product_progression.meaning: Individual coding skills combine into realistic assignments.
Case knowledge expands into visual orchestration/data-movement practice.
Pipeline concepts operate against a broader realistic data platform.

data_and_content_flows.rule: CaseLab may consume generated Contoso fixtures without owning the generator/platform.
FactoryLab may use Contoso source/target datasets for pipeline exercises.
Single-skill drills may graduate into multi-step cases.

runtime_flows.split: Datapass: thin PySpark execution. CaseLab: deeper Spark execution/diagnostics/simulation.
Datapass: compile/validate/DAG preview. CaseLab: scheduler semantics, retries, triggers, failures, timeline.
FactoryLab Fabric-semantic/control adapter; do not duplicate Duckle's general ETL executor if the integration spike succeeds.
Primary lower-layer candidate for real visual ETL/data-flow execution, DuckDB/DuckLake work, previews, lineage, scheduling and run evidence.

airflow_placement.datapass: Thin Airflow Python scratchpad: parse/validate/DAG preview and interview questions.
airflow_placement.caselab: Deep Airflow teaching: scheduler states, retries, trigger rules, failures, backfills/timelines/XCom-like concepts via fastapiflow.
airflow_placement.factorylab: No Airflow simulator. May later teach interoperability by invoking FactoryLab/Duckle pipelines from Airflow.
airflow_placement.contoso: No Airflow product surface by default; it may be used externally to orchestrate platform jobs.

ownership_rules: dbt platform ownership -> Contoso; CaseLab may have bounded dbt exercises; Datapass should not own dbt Studio.
data generation + dimensional analytics platform ownership -> Contoso.
React Flow may be reused across Airflow DAG, Data Factory pipeline, Mapping Data Flow and Duckle-derived graphs, but their schemas/semantics remain separate.
Notebook UI/Monaco can be reused, but each product owns its own product state and learning workflows.
Duckle may provide FactoryLab's lower execution layer; it does not change product ownership or make FactoryLab an Airflow product.
